# Claude 2.1.209 native parent capture

Captured from the installed Linux Claude 2.1.209 ELF in an isolated, network-disabled container through a private tmux session. The native CLI accepted one literal typed input. The loopback provider refused the subsequent request, so this fixture proves native user provenance and startup metadata only; it does not qualify model replies, tools, descendants, or later typed inputs.

The public JSONL preserves all seven physical rows, envelope identities, UUID links, timestamps, provenance fields, and the literal test input. Installed agent description strings and the skill-listing prose were replaced with redaction markers; catalog names and structural fields remain. No credentials, personal paths, or customer content are present.
